question: What is the biggest thing you ever got away with at work?
story: I got promoted twice at a company where nobody could tell you what my job actually was. I was hired as a temp to cover one week of filing. The person who hired me quit two days in, and nobody told HR. My badge kept working, so I kept showing up. I found an empty desk on the fourth floor and started answering the phone nobody else answered. People began forwarding me things. I made a spreadsheet. Then a second spreadsheet. Within four months I was in a meeting explaining those spreadsheets to a director, and he called me indispensable. Here is the part I still cannot believe. Payroll had me listed as an outside vendor, so for eleven months I was invoicing at temp rates while sitting in leadership meetings. I finally asked to be made official. They gave me a title, a raise, and a parking spot.
